about.title: About me
description: Unity and C# engineer with 8 years of commercial game development across PC and mobile. Focused on gameplay systems architecture, ScriptableObject-driven data pipelines, and custom Unity editor tooling.

Built cross-platform codebases with shared core logic and platform-specific builds, multiplayer sync systems, and in-game store and inventory flows. Comfortable owning features end to end with high autonomy in a remote team.
